entities.name: Additional GUTI
entities.description: Information element that the UE includes under specific conditions related to TIN value and valid GUTI/P-TMSI/RAI availability or during inter-system change.

entities.name: TIN indicates P-TMSI with valid GUTI, P-TMSI and RAI
entities.description: Condition where the Temporary Identity used in Next update (TIN) indicates P-TMSI and the UE holds valid GUTI, P-TMSI and Routing Area Identity.

entities.name: N1 mode to S1 mode inter-system change with valid GUTI
entities.description: Condition where the UE performs an inter-system change from N1 mode to S1 mode and holds a valid GUTI.

entities.name: TIN
entities.description: Temporary Identity used in Next update, which can indicate different temporary identities like P-TMSI.

entities.name: GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identity used to identify the UE.

entities.name: P-TMSI
entities.description: Packet Temporary Mobile Subscriber Identity used in packet switched domains.

entities.name: RAI
entities.description: Routing Area Identity identifying the routing area in packet switched domains.

relations.description: The inclusion of Additional GUTI IE is guarded by the condition that TIN indicates P-TMSI and UE holds valid GUTI, P-TMSI and RAI.
The inclusion of Additional GUTI IE is guarded by the condition that UE performs N1 mode to S1 mode inter-system change and holds a valid GUTI.
The condition depends on the TIN identifier indicating P-TMSI.
The condition requires the UE to hold a valid GUTI.
The condition requires the UE to hold a valid P-TMSI.
The condition requires the UE to hold a valid RAI.
The condition requires the UE to hold a valid GUTI during inter-system change.
